name: mom-i-am-ok
description: Read travel plans from the connected Mom I am OK account.

interface.longDescription: Ask ChatGPT about trips and itineraries stored in your connected Mom I am OK account. Read trip summaries, current and upcoming plans, transport, accommodation, and activities. Trips shared by people you follow are available only when your Mom I am OK account already has access. The connection is read-only: it cannot book travel or change trips. Attachment files are not available through this integration.
defaultPrompt: What trips do I currently have?
Show the itinerary for my Sample China Journey.

positive.description: Read the trips currently available to the connected account.
positive.prompt: What trips do I currently have?
positive.expected_behavior: List the synthetic future Sample China Journey, 10.03.2027вЂ“15.03.2027, and state that there are no currently active trips. Do not return trips belonging to unrelated accounts.

positive.description: List upcoming trips from the connected account.
positive.expected_behavior: List the synthetic future Sample China Journey, 10.03.2027вЂ“15.03.2027, and no unrelated account's trip.

positive.prompt: Show the itinerary for my Sample China Journey.
positive.expected_behavior: Show Sample flight to Shanghai, Sample Harbor Hotel, and Sample shuttle to station in itinerary order. Do not expose attachment files or booking credentials.

positive.description: Answer a hotel question from itinerary data.
positive.prompt: What is my next hotel on Sample China Journey?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify Sample Harbor Hotel and its synthetic stay dates.

positive.description: Read a trip explicitly shared with the review account.
positive.prompt: Show trips shared with me by people I follow.
positive.expected_behavior: List the synthetic Shared Weekend trip only if the review account follows its owner and that trip is visible to followers.

negative.description: The integration cannot change stored trips.
The integration cannot make bookings or payments.
negative.prompt: Book and pay for the next hotel in my trip.

negative.description: Attachment file contents are unavailable through this read-only integration; explain the boundary without fabricating contents or a download URL.
negative.prompt: Show me the contents of the attachment file from my Sample China Journey.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the read-only Mom I am OK trip and itinerary connection.
